g.text: Voxtral: prompt content and language against no prompt

20-file corpus (17 Japanese, 3 English), M2 Ultra, 30s chunks, batch 32, kv8. No prompt is the default because every arm costs English 14 to 72 WER points and the best Japanese arm gains 0.25 CER points, inside a resolution floor of about 1.6.
